title: SE implementation scratchpad - Ironclad Trust
content:
Daily scratchpad - Ironclad Trust (customer kickoff + config notes)
Owner: Aisha K. - SE lead
Collabs: Ben (infra), Lina (security), Samir (onboarding)

Context / goals:
- PoC to run Ironclad's contract-review assistant in dedicated capacity for POC (90-day eval).
- Data residency: must remain in customer VPC; Private deployment preferred but customer willing to try Dedicated with VPC peering first.
- Compliance: SOC2 + client-specific NDA; they want KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance.

High-level plan (phases):
- Phase 0: discovery + infra mapping (done)
- Phase 1: Dedicated pool + model onboarding + basic prompts (target 2 weeks)
- Phase 2: Private control-plane + HSM/KMS + strict network controls (target 4-6 weeks)
- Phase 3: Scale + SLO tuning + rollouts (ongoing)

Open questions (to resolve in next sync):
- Which model variant do they prefer? They asked for Llama-2-13B quantized near-INT8 for cost. Need to confirm accuracy floor.
- Acceptable latency SLO? They mentioned interactive (<600ms median) for short documents (<=1k tokens). Could be tough on 13B quantized under heavy batching.
- Logging retention policy for audit logs (they want 12 months). Need to confirm retention + compliance costs.

Technical checklist / TODOs:
- [ ] Provision dedicated GPU pool in us-east-1 (try p4d-like shapes); assign to customer tenant id CT-IRNCLD-001. (Ben)
- [ ] Create VPC peering request template for Ironclad networking team. Include specific subnets/IP ranges + security group suggestions. (Ben/Lina)
- [ ] KMS integration: document key rotation and bring-your-own-key flow. Confirm HSM requirement. (Lina)
- [ ] Model quantization test: run baseline eval on Llama-2-13B Q4_8 to verify hallucination rate on contract QA prompts. Record token usage & latency. (Samir)
- [ ] Prepare prompt-safe defaults + redaction pattern for PII before sending to model. (Aisha/Samir)
- [ ] Create rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to smaller model. Write config snippet for Console. (Aisha)

Config notes (scratch):
- tenant_id: CT-IRNCLD-001
- region: us-east-1 (primary); fallback us-west-2
- deployment: dedicated-pool-ironclad-v1
- model_candidate: llama-2-13b-q4_8
- batch_policy: latency_slo_ms=600; max_batch_size=8; prefer_immediate=true
- cache: enable_prefix_cache=true; cache_ttl=300s for repeated contract clauses
- logging: audit_logs -> splunk.hec://splunk.ironclad.example:8088; auth_token=REDACTED_PLACEHOLDER
- kms: customer-kms://projects/ironclad/keys/rw-infer-key; rotate_interval_days=90

Evaluation plan:
- Create small eval set: 120 contract excerpts (clauses + questions). Focus on QA, redaction, clause extraction.
- Metrics: F1 for clause extraction, precision@1 for QA, hallucination flag rate (manual triage initially).
- Cost targets: aim < $0.015 per 1k tokens served at target throughput (estimate after quantization and batching).

Meeting notes (quick):
- 2026-02-25 sync: Ironclad security asked for HSM-only for signing keys; curious if Redwood supports HSM for Private only. Need to escalate to infra + legal for Dedicated HSM option.
- Ironclad product wants canary + manual approval before full rollout. Good.

Risks / mitigation:
- Risk: latency targets missed under contention. Mitigation: add autoscale config + smaller model fallback and synchronous streaming.
- Risk: KMS/HSM compliance not satisfied on Dedicated. Mitigation: propose Private deployment pilot; provide architectural diagram + compliance artifact pack.

Next steps (short timeline):
- Today: send VPC peering template + ask for IP ranges (Aisha)
- Wed: infra to spin up dedicated pool stub with test model (Ben)
- Fri: run first quantization eval and share numbers (Samir)
- Next week: security deep-dive with Ironclad (Lina + Aisha)

Notes-to-self: keep notes terse in GH issue for infra work; tag with SE-1234 and set due dates. Remember to redact real tokens in Drive; store secrets in Vault only.

Scratch end.
